narrative.overview: This is an Operate surface: the first screen starts a real compression task. Scope is the homepage only; the existing editor and batch views retain their own controls. The existing compression logo and magenta action color remain the identity.
dos: Do preserve single-image, batch and offline workflows.
Do reuse the project's actual image assets and native file picker.
donts: Don't add clipboard controls or fabricated compression statistics.
Don't introduce decorative animation, floating sections or new dependencies.
